assessment: A strong, well-structured response that presents two clear options with correct amounts, avoids double-counting the $12 express fee, makes no arrival guarantees, and uses 'request' language appropriately. The main weakness is the confidently asserted no-reinstatement rule, which is not supported by the case notes and could materially affect the customer's decision; the promise to email a printable gift note is also an unverified execution capability. Empathy is genuine but front-loaded, with later turns turning purely transactional.
judge_agreement: Judges broadly agreed the response is clear, accurate on amounts and refund timing, and honest about limitations (most scores clustered at 7-9). The sharpest disagreement was on policy_honesty: OpenAI (6) and Anthropic (7) flagged the invented reinstatement policy, while Gemini (10), DeepSeek (9), and Qwen (9) saw no issue. Gemini was a consistent positive outlier, awarding perfect 10s across all criteria; three of five judges noted the empathy for the missed express-delivery promise could be more explicit.
